overlap.formal_difference: No difference interval is reported between the Feynman benchmark and the expanded Feynman corpus, because the benchmark equations are part of the expanded corpus. Equation resampling assumes independence between disjoint branches. Joint chapter resampling preserves shared-chapter dependence.

fr.note: Refit after storing F(R)=R+f(R) for the three Nojiri–Odintsov models. Seed 20261013, untrimmed, 10000 equation resamples. Corpus-difference intervals that include f(R) still use the earlier 10-form draws.
